newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia pedicab driver given death sentence.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia pedicab driver given death sentence.

text.p: A 19-year-old Indonesian pedicab driver has been sentenced to death in the city of Surabaya for the murders of a family of four earlier this year, the Jakarta Post newspaper reported on Friday.

The paper said the court found Sugianto guilty of killing the husband, wife and two children on February 15 this year because he wanted to steal their motorbike which he planned to sell to pay back his employer after his pedicab was stolen.

"The murder was sadistic. He beat the victims to death with a stick. Some of the victims were children. It finished the lineage of the Soekardjo (family)," chief judge Soebijakto said in his decision.
Sugianto's lawyers were quoted as saying they would need time to decide if they would appeal the decision.
